versions.content: The IocSendGroup / IocWriteGroup function shall support mechanisms to guarantee data-Integrity during transmission. The IocSendGroup / IocWriteGroup function shall solve the crossing of the protec- tion boundaries of OS-Applications. It has to be generated in case of intra-core and inter-core communication.
